name: demark_sequential_v1
mechanism: On NIFTY at 5-second bars, a TD Sequential buy setup (9 consecutive 5s bars each closing below their 4-bar-ago close) captures a 45-second sustained micro-selldown where incremental sellers dominate at each price step. When the 9-count completes with DeMark perfection (bar 8 or 9 registers a lower low than bar 6 of the setup), the marginal sellers have been absorbed by resting buy orders at progressively deeper levels — supply is structurally exhausted. NIFTY's institutional-driven price discovery then snaps back within 1-3 bars as delta-hedging market makers and VWAP-benchmarked algos resume upward reference price tracking, producing a 10-20 spot point counter-move in the first 30-60 seconds. The sell setup is symmetric: 9 consecutive closes above close[4] with perfected higher high on bar 8 or 9 signals buyer exhaustion, triggering a buy PE.
core_signal_oneliner: 9 consecutive 5-second bars each closing below/above the bar 4 periods ago, with DeMark perfection on bar 8 or 9 and RSI confirmation, marking micro-trend exhaustion
